decision_rules.REPRODUCED: two clean replicas are bitwise canonical-equal and match a trusted canonical legacy reference under the preregistered exact identity contract
decision_rules.RECONSTRUCTED_NOT_REPRODUCED: two clean replicas are bitwise canonical-equal and pass preregistered numeric tolerances but no trusted canonical legacy reference identity exists
decision_rules.REPRODUCTION_FAILED: safety and structural contracts pass but determinism or preregistered numeric equivalence does not pass
decision_rules.REJECTED: human review declines to accept the evidence without upgrading any computed outcome
decision_rules.INVALID: approval scope lineage probability capability or safety contract violation
